title: Playwright vs Cypress: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Playwright vs Cypress: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: Playwright's multi-process architecture generally offers higher parallel execution potential.
• Latency: Playwright's protocol-based communication can lead to lower latency than Cypress's in-browser execution model for complex interactions.
• Consistency: Both strive for consistency, but Playwright's network interception and request/response management can offer more robust control.
• Failure Modes: Playwright's isolation between tests and processes can prevent cascading failures more effectively than Cypress's single-process approach.
• Operational Overhead: Playwright can have a slightly steeper initial setup but often scales more gracefully in CI/CD pipelines due to its architecture.

Recommendation: For production environments demanding high scalability and robust execution, Playwright is the preferred choice due to its architecture.
